thread:
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Quick ask 1 — we have an L5 Backend hire (London-based) who needs a sign-on split request: 50% now, 50% after 6 months. Their base is at top of band but they want the sign-on due to notice period loss. Also their UK visa says earliest start 2026-05-03 but candidate asked if we can make start 2026-04-15 if paperwork allows. Can comp/finance/legal weigh in?
Priya (People Ops): Thanks Aisha. Two things to confirm: 1) why split sign-on (e.g., retention / clawback rationale), 2) whether the back half should be conditional on employment at 6 months. Also need evidence of NOTICE pay or other loss.
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Candidate is giving up a 3-month garden leave payout to join us sooner. They asked for split because the former employer only pays after their notice ends. We want to make them whole and reduce risk they change plans. Proposed: base 124k GBP (within band), RSU 25k 4y, sign-on total 12k GBP (6k now, 6k after 6 months).
Marco (Comp & Ben): This is nonstandard for UK hires but doable. We require a standard retention clause for the second tranche (clawback if they leave before 6 months). Please add the former employer loss evidence and a short business case for the retention need.
Lena (Immigration): On the start date: visa earliest start 2026-05-03 according to CoS. We cant legally put them on payroll before that. If candidate asked for 2026-04-15 we can offer unpaid early onboarding activities (non-work, orientation) but not contractually employ them. People Ops should add language to the offer explaining visa start and permissible pre-start interactions.
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Got it. Candidate is OK with unpaid orientation but prefers earlier paid start if possible. They said their lawyer is appealing for earlier CoS; unclear outcome.
Priya (People Ops): Routing to @comp-committee and @finance. people-ops-bot: created approval PR-6022 for sign-on split + retention clause. Please attach proof of lost garden-leave payout (screenshot or letter).
Ahmed (Finance): FYI we need to decide if sign-on second tranche is capitalized as hiring expense vs. retention reserve. Also clarify budget owner. Aisha, which code?
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Charge to ENG-BE-08.
Marco (Comp & Ben): Process note: include the comp table showing requested vs band, retention clause text, proof of former payout, and immigration caveat. With that I'll recommend approve.
Priya (People Ops): Legal Bot, can you draft the 6-month retention clause and the visa pre-start wording?
Legal Bot: Generated clause: "Second tranche of sign-on (6k GBP) payable after 6 months of continuous employment; clawback if employee resigns within 12 months." Also flagged that immigration-prestart activities must be unpaid and limited to onboarding admin. No other issues.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set for comp-committee review in 8 hours.
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Uploaded garden-leave letter and candidates immigration case note to PR-6022.
Marco (Comp & Ben): Reviewed docs. Recommend approve pending finance budget classification. Marking as recommend approve.
Ahmed (Finance): Confirmed charge ENG-BE-08; sign-on split approved if second tranche is expensed to hiring pool and clawback language included. Approve.
Priya (People Ops): Comp-committee approved via reaction. Legal clause applied to offer template, offer updated to reflect visa earliest start 2026-05-03 and optional unpaid onboarding from 2026-04-15. Aisha please send final offer and mention second tranche will be paid after 6 full months and subject to clawback.
Aisha (Hiring Manager): Will send now. Candidate asked whether we can expedite payroll setup to avoid delays 1. Priya, will benefits enrollment be available on day one of paid start?
Priya (People Ops): Benefits enrollment will open on day one of paid employment; we will provide provisional enrollment instructions in the offer packet. Closing thread once offer is signed. :white_check_mark:
